preconditions.description: The number of test cases t must be between 1 and 10,000.
The number of vertices n in each test case must be between 1 and 200,000.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= b[i] <= n for i in range(n))
preconditions.description: Each element in the ancestor array b must be a valid vertex index.

preconditions.expression: len(set(p)) == n and all(1 <= p[i] <= n for i in range(n))
preconditions.description: The permutation p must contain all vertices from 1 to n exactly once.

postconditions.expression: stdout == '-1' if not possible else len(stdout.split()) == n
postconditions.description: If no solution exists, output -1; otherwise, output n edge weights.

postconditions.expression: all(1 <= int(w) <= 10**9 for w in stdout.split() if w != '0')
postconditions.description: All edge weights must be between 1 and 10^9, except for the root's weight which is 0.

postconditions.expression: sorted([dist[p[i]] for i in range(n)]) == list(range(n))
postconditions.description: The distances from the root must form a permutation of 0 to n-1.
